about.odds_by_rarity: Chance for the whole rarity tier, as the source states it. Inside a tier every item is equally likely: the in-game 'Chances Per Item' screen (added Sep 1, 2026) shows each item as tier % / number of items in the tier. 'Chroma' is a separate line the game shows under Godly.
about.pct: Number in percent (0.2 means 0.2%). null when the source gives no exact figure; the source text is then in pct_text.
about.sum_note: The tier odds add up to 100.2% (70+15+10+5+0.2, or 70+18+8+4+0.2), plus the 0.004% Chroma line. The in-game screen itself shows these figures, so the extra 0.2% is not a wiki typo; the game does not say how the Godly roll fits into the 100%. Treat the figures as the game's rounded display.
about.pct_per_item: Only set where a source shows the per-item figure (in-game screenshots of Summer Box '26 and the Common Egg). Elsewhere, divide the tier pct by the item count in that tier.
about.slug: DropMarket values_items slug for murder-mystery-2 (prod catalogue, read 2026-10-05). null when the item is not in our catalogue.
about.mystery_key: A Mystery Key opens one permanent weapon box (not the Common Egg or event boxes). The Shop sells it for 125 Diamonds, so a key spin bought with Diamonds costs more than the 100-Diamond direct spin (wiki Mystery Key page). Keys are also tradable and given in events.
about.rarity_on_items: The box tier the item sits in. Chroma items use rarity 'Chroma' (the wiki labels them Godly) so they join to the Chroma odds line.

boxes.name: Mystery Box 2
boxes.odds_basis: Wiki box page. On Sep 1, 2026 the wiki replaced 'unknown' Godly/Chroma chances with 0.2% / 0.004% after MM2 added an in-game 'Item Chances' screen. The tier split (70/15/10/5/0.2 + Chroma 0.004) matches the in-game screen for the Common Egg; no in-game screenshot of this box was found.
boxes.notes: Only box with two Godlies (Lightbringer, Darkbringer) and two Chromas. The wiki lists 0.2% next to each Godly and 0.004% next to each Chroma. By the in-game rule (tier % / items in tier) the 0.2% Godly tier would be 0.1% each; no screenshot of this box's Item Chances screen was found, so that is unconfirmed. Added in the March 2020 Update; its weapons cannot be salvaged or crafted (wiki).

boxes.name: Common Egg
boxes.odds_basis: In-game 'Chances Per Item' screen, screenshot posted Sep 1, 2026 by @Colbemo: Common 70% (Cat, Dog, Bunny 23.33% each), Uncommon 15% (Pig, Fox 7.5% each), Rare 10% (Bear), Legendary 5% (Bat), Godly 0.2% (each Fire pet 0.2%/7 = 0.029%), Chroma 0.004%.
boxes.notes: The wiki tables are wrong here and we did not use them: they give Common 60%, Pig 'Uncommon 60%', Fox 25%, and 0.2% for EACH Fire pet. The in-game screen shows 70/15/10/5 and 0.029% per Fire pet. The screen shows one 'Chroma - 0.004%' line and does not split it across the 7 Chroma Fire pets, so pct_per_item is null for them. No Mystery Key option (Coins or Diamonds only). Replaced the Pet Box in Season 1.

boxes.name: 2026 Summer Box
boxes.odds_basis: Wiki box page, matching the in-game 'Chances Per Item' screen in the Sep 1, 2026 @Colbemo screenshot: Common 70% (17.5% each), Uncommon 18% (6% each), Rare 8% (4% each), Legendary 4%, Godly 0.2%, Chroma 0.004%.
boxes.notes: Event box (Summer Event 2026, ended Aug 23, 2026). The Sep 1, 2026 screenshot still shows this box in the Shop with a 60-Diamond button, nine days after the event ended. We could not confirm whether it can be opened today, so in_shop is false, in line with the events and how-to-get files. Wiki page title: "Summer Box '26". Some third-party guides give the Chroma as '<0.1%'; the in-game screen says 0.004%.
